test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 09
subject: general
question: Which of the following is not true in regard to the exchange rate of Indian Rupee ?

options.text: Mainly, its price is in terms of US Dollar.
It is decided by Reserve Bank of India.
It is published by Reserve bank of India.
It is decided by market forces.

solution: All prices are quoted in dollar terms and the local currency is no longer used in transactions. Reserve bank of India (RBI) wishes to fix an exact par value for the rupee. Most exchange rates change slightly on a day-to-day basis, and market forces generally determine the basic trends.
